# Rough Guides

> > Comprehensive travel planning resource offering destination guides, expert itineraries, and practical travel advice for independent travelers worldwide.

Rough Guides provides in-depth travel information spanning Europe, South America, Australia, and beyond, with expert-curated content covering everything from backpacking tips to wildlife guides. The site connects travelers with local experts and offers both popular destinations and off-the-beaten-path recommendations.

## Key Topics

- Travel planning and itinerary design
- Budget travel and backpacking
- National parks and nature travel
- South America destinations (Argentina, Brazil, Panama)
- European travel (Albania, Croatia, Scotland, Sweden)
- Australia travel tips and working holidays
- Local experts and custom itineraries
- Accommodation guides and homestays
- Wildlife and outdoor adventures
- Solo travel safety
- Cultural tourism and hidden destinations
- Seasonal travel timing
- Photography and travel documentation
